messages:
Elaine M: Quick ask — preparing a short product demo + blog post next Tue. Need a performance snapshot we can call out: p50/p90/p95/p99 latencies, tokens/response, and coldstart vs steady-state for our gen & embed endpoints.
Tom R: got it. Which models + precisions should we run? quantized too?
Elaine M: primary: llama-70b and opt-13b, both float16 and int8-quantized variants if possible. For embeddings, use all-sim-2. Run on our hosted config and a Dedicated-capacity snapshot.
Sandeep K: suggest these cohorts: short gen (<=64 tokens), medium (256 tokens), long (1024). 1k requests per cohort per variant, 2 warmup passes, prefix cache off and on. Also capture p50/p90/p95/p99 and p99.9.
Elaine M: perfect. Also include a tiny CSV with aggregated rows we can paste into the post: model, precision, cohort, p50,p90,p95,p99,avg_tokens,requests. And one representative raw payload per cohort.
Tom R: copying our runbook snippet here: https://go.redwood/perf-runbook (internal). Command we're using for the harness:
```
./perf_harness --model=llama-70b --precision=int8 --profile=demo_snapshot --requests=1000 --seq=256 --warmup=2 --cache=off --seed=42
```
Olivia C: can marketing get a short TL;DR table by EOD tomorrow? just top-line numbers + 3 sample payloads.
perf-bot: perf-job queued: job_id=pc-1748276600-42. Estimated runtime ~45m. Link: https://perf.redwood/jobs/pc-1748276600-42
Tom R: queued. Will run both hosted & dedicated snapshots, will post artifacts (CSV + link to raw artifacts) once done. Will also note hardware used (A100-80GB) and that autoscaling is disabled for Dedicated run.
Elaine M: thanks — can you also capture the coldstart first-token latency (first token after idle)? that's important for demo experience.
Sandeep K: noted. We'll record first-token latency, steady-state tokens/s, and attach an explanation of the warmup policy.
Tom R: first hosted run finished. Small summary CSV below; raw traces uploading now.
Tom R:
model,precision,cohort,p50_ms,p90_ms,p95_ms,p99_ms,avg_tokens,requests,first_token_ms,tokens_per_sec
llama-70b,float16,short,32,55,70,120,45,1000,18,210
llama-70b,int8,short,40,70,95,150,45,1000,22,230
opt-13b,float16,short,18,30,40,65,38,1000,10,480
opt-13b,int8,short,20,34,46,78,38,1000,12,510
llama-70b,float16,medium,85,140,190,300,270,1000,28,195
llama-70b,int8,medium,110,170,230,380,270,1000,34,225
...
Tom R: uploaded artifacts: https://storage.internal.redwood/perf/pc-1748276600-42.tar.gz (contains raw payloads, traces, aggregated CSV, and the run command).
Olivia C: perfect — this is exactly what I need for the post. Please add a 2-3 sentence methodology blurb to the GDrive draft: mention warmup passes, random seed, cache toggle, and that Dedicated run used fixed capacity (no autoscale).
Tom R: added methodology note to the draft and pinned it in the perf job page.
Elaine M: awesome, thanks team. We'll make sure the blog calls out int8 tradeoffs and first-token impact. :rocket:
